model_profile.mzi_unitary: U(theta, phi) = i exp(i theta/2) [[exp(i phi) sin(theta/2), exp(i phi) cos(theta/2)], [cos(theta/2), -sin(theta/2)]]
model_profile.detector: per_mesh_intensity uses physical square-law detection after each mesh; per_mesh_coherent and coherent_stack are ablations
model_profile.shared_mask_meaning: 1 means a design-time trainable cross-task common 2x2 unit with no task delta; 0 means task-private phase deltas are enabled
model_profile.mpu_deployment_semantics: After training, shared_mask=1 units are fabricated/fixed as passive MPU transfer matrices using the learned common theta/phi. The training metric is multi-task accuracy only.
